I am not the author for the #40498 PR, but I find this PR useful for me to formalize solutions of olympiad geometry problems. I have the equvalent version of angle_eq_of_oangle_eq in https://github.com/dwrensha/compfiles/blob/main/Compfiles/Imo2014P4.lean and https://github.com/dwrensha/compfiles/blob/main/Compfiles/Imo2023P2.lean , illustrating its usefulness.

Can anyone have a look at it again?
